note: What a patron can supply and what he wants, drawn from one list so that specialty and need are the same kind of thing (patrons.md section 3). Everything except rivals is a shipment: it arrives, or the PC sends it, and a patron with his own means is wealthy enough to move goods across an ocean - that is all the machinery it takes. No prose here: the folder carries no language suffix, so the words a letter uses for a specialty belong in data/letters_en with the letter that says them.
